description: Load Axiom's documented routing gate at session start, and print Axiom's static checks when a prompt arrives and before the turn ends.

hooks.command: printf '%s\n\n' 'You have Axiom. Load this startup front door before deciding whether any Axiom skill applies:'; cat "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/using-axiom/SKILL.md"

printf '%s\n' 'Axiom: before acting, decide whether this request has a material ambiguity that context cannot resolve. If it does, clarify it first as the routing gate directs; if not, proceed. Tentative wording alone is not ambiguity.'
